responses: Namaste! Main ANNDISHA assistant hoon. Aap mujhse token, payment, procurement ya complaint se related sawal pooch sakte hain.
Hello! Kaise madad kar sakta hoon aapki?
Dhanyavaad! Zarurat pade to phir se pooch lena.
Alvida! Aapka din shubh ho.
Aapka swagat hai!
Koi baat nahi, hamesha madad ke liye yahin hoon.

patterns: mera token approve hua ya nahi
responses: Aap apna token status Farmer portal ke 'Live Queue' section mein dekh sakte hain.
Token status ke liye Dashboard > Live Queue pe jaayein, wahan real-time status dikhega.
Payment status dekhne ke liye Farmer portal ke 'Payments' section mein jaayein.
Agar payment 7 din se zyada pending hai to complaint darj karayein, hum jaldi resolve karenge.
Procurement schedule aapko Dashboard pe 'Procurement' section mein dikhega.
Officer ne aapka procurement slot assign kiya hai, use Notifications mein check karein.

patterns: meri fasal register nahi ho rahi
responses: Fasal register karne ke liye Farmer portal mein 'My Crops' > 'Add New Crop' pe click karein.
Crop registration ke liye zaruri documents (khasra number, aadhar) upload karna hoga.

patterns: meri complaint ka jawab nahi aaya
responses: Complaint darj karne ke liye Farmer portal mein 'Support' ya 'Complaint' section use karein.
Aap apni complaint ka status Notifications section mein track kar sakte hain.

patterns: login mein error aa raha hai
responses: Agar login nahi ho raha to 'Forgot Password' option use karein ya registered mobile number check karein.
Agar OTP nahi aa raha to kuch der baad retry karein ya support se contact karein.

patterns: officer ne verify kiya ya nahi
responses: Verification status Dashboard ke 'Verification' card mein dikhega.
Officer aapki details verify karne ke baad status automatically update ho jayega.
Admin Payments section se aap bulk payments process aur approve kar sakte hain.
Payment approve karne ke liye AdminPayments page mein farmer select karke 'Approve' click karein.
Farmer registration ke liye 'Sign Up' page pe jaakar apna naam, mobile number aur aadhar details bharein.
Registration ke baad officer verification hone tak account pending rahega.
Weighing process procurement center pe officer dwara ki jaati hai, slip Live Queue mein dikhegi.
Weighing ke baad aapko digital slip Notifications mein mil jayegi.
Aap Officer ke contact details Dashboard ke 'Contact' section mein pa sakte hain.
Officer se direct baat karne ke liye Support ticket raise karein, officer response karega.

patterns: aap kya kya kar sakte ho
responses: Main token status, payment status, procurement status, crop registration, complaint aur login issues mein madad kar sakta hoon.
Bas apna sawal pooch dijiye, main koshish karunga sahi jawab dene ki.
